speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. I see you are an 8-month-old boy with feeding difficulties and abdominal distension; can you tell me if you are having trouble passing gas or stool, and if your abdomen feels firm or swollen when I touch it?

speaker: Patient
text: The baby has been very fussy, feeding less than usual, and the abdomen looks distended. Crying gets worse when the belly is touched.

speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for that information; since crying worsens with touch and he is fussy, does the abdomen become visible as a scaphoid (sunken) shape between episodes of crying, and have you noticed any vomiting, specifically if it is green or bilious?

speaker: Patient
text: There has not been fever, vomiting, or diarrhea like a stomach infection. The baby was born at 39 weeks without birth complications.
